an4.29:2.1: Good will, mendicants, is a footprint of the Dhamma that is primordial, long-standing, customary, and traditional. It is uncorrupted, as it has been since the beginning. It’s not being corrupted now nor will it be. Sensible ascetics and brahmins don’t look down on it.
